campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine: Rank by fastest progress: model capability and validation first, then changes that make every later landing cheaper, then cleanup; owner-blocked and long-horizon rows last. Consolidate duplicated logic into fewer general components rather than adding instrumentation or frameworks; net AST nodes stay flat or fall, and the clone and harness ratchets hold the floor. Delete stale data and consolidate objects to reduce surface and improve robustness and efficiency: reviewed source lives in git, derived records in OvergoDB, process state in .overgo-runtime, and nothing a tool or evidence depends on lives in tmp. A consolidation row is done only when it deletes the implementations it replaces: test the shared owner's contract, keep only meaningful caller integration checks, retire tests of deleted wrappers, and report net production and test code removed, repeated executions eliminated, gate wall time and peak memory on comparable changes. Across the 197 first-parent commits to 2026-09-23, production Go grew about 9,000 net lines and tests about 11,600. OvergoDB keeps its core -- immutable content, a durable journal, aliases, rebuildable projections -- and the repository simplifies how it uses it, in order: integrity and blocking defects, one publication path, bounded queries, one record per transition, bounded memory, declared storage policy, then bounded segments. Store rows report bytes and records added per landing, records scanned per query, open and replay time, writer wait, peak memory and compaction write volume. No new model family, workflow, optimizer or orchestration framework without an owner request. A step's verify is its machine check; a check whose prerequisite cannot run records UNAVAILABLE, not a pass. depends_on names real producers. GUI and audio keep their lanes; master runs as master-lead. docs/plan.json is the only live plan.

items.title: Let an atomic replace proceed when the holder releases the file, not when it exits

steps.title: Let an atomic replace proceed when the holder releases the file, not when it exits
steps.rationale: Review 2026-09-23 (P1): the Windows replace from 92781cc0 waits on the holding process's exit (replace_windows.go:141). A long-lived process that releases its mapping and stays alive blocks publication indefinitely. The test released the file and exited, so it missed this. Retry on release: re-attempt the rename whenever the holder list changes or shrinks, and name the holder while waiting.

items.title: Bound a pack index by its file before allocating

steps.title: Bound a pack index by its file before allocating
steps.rationale: Review 2026-09-23 (P2): readPackIndex allocates from the header's entry count before checking the file length or arithmetic bounds (blob_pack.go:77). A damaged count causes an excessive allocation or a panic before checksum validation. Reject any count whose index cannot fit in the file, and any overflow, before allocating.

items.title: Publish through one store path: idempotent writes, verified content fill, alias-local preconditions

steps.title: Publish through one store path: idempotent writes, verified content fill, alias-local preconditions
steps.rationale: Integrity and blocking first. A store that already holds a bare descriptor refuses the later batch carrying its content (artifactFacet.validate), which blocks lane outcomes; 66420d36 avoids new bare records but repairs none. Build on the commit coordinator (commit_coordinator.go:44) so every caller shares idempotent publication, content verification, alias compare-and-set and conflict reporting. Treat descriptor-exists and content-available as distinct states, with one supported path to fill an existing descriptor with matching, verified content. A caller declares whether its decision depends on the whole head. Alias-local operations take only their alias precondition, so unrelated writers do not invalidate them. Keep expensive preparation outside the write lock. Done when the bare-record repair works, the per-caller publication and retry code is deleted, and writer wait is measured before and after.

items.title: Fail a browser leg when the browser stops answering, and name the leg

steps.title: Fail a browser leg when the browser stops answering, and name the leg
steps.rationale: The webui lane after 2a9b5df6 lost 20 minutes: TestWebUIBrowserAudioOutput blocked in webSocket.readText waiting for a DevTools reply that never came, and the package timeout reported only a stack. Every browser wait uses t.Context, with no deadline. The fixed-timer census refuses a fixed per-leg deadline, so derive the failure: the browser process exited, the socket closed, or the page made no progress across a derived interval. Report the leg by name.

items.title: Make store queries proportional to the results they return

steps.title: Make store queries proportional to the results they return
steps.rationale: VisitDocuments (documents.go:55) walks the whole artifact history under the read lock on every call. After the page fills it keeps scanning to count Matched. A cursor does not seek; it rescans from the start and skips, so paging a collection is quadratic, and every artifact is tested against the query contracts. Seek from the cursor over the existing descriptor indexes, stop after the page plus one match, and make an exact total an explicit census operation. Current-state readers resolve an alias or run a bounded query instead of rebuilding latest from history. Done when records scanned per query track the page size, not the store size.

items.title: Publish one durable record per meaningful transition

steps.title: Publish one durable record per meaningful transition
steps.rationale: Content addressing removes identical bytes, not the same fact in different envelopes. A completed check publishes its result once. Package receipts, batch progress, plan completion, benchmark rows and reports reference that result rather than repeat its measurements, environment or source manifest. Related facts and alias moves ride one existing transaction. Heartbeats and partial output stay out of the durable catalog. Evidence schemas change, so readers accept the old and new shapes until retained evidence migrates. Done when bytes and records added per landing fall and the duplicated envelopes are deleted from the writers.

items.title: Land every change through one entry point

steps.title: Land every change through one entry point
steps.rationale: loop -land, plan -edit -publish, a direct gate run and gate -merge each own claim, budget, ship-set and recovery handling (land.go:96). On 2026-09-23 three plan-only commits existed only to change a check, and a merge into master needed its row published first. Keep the command interfaces, but make each invoke one landing implementation, with the differences passed as data: reuse the worker's claim, take the budget from the measured delta, split a check change into its own commit, file a first-parent merge's row. Done when ordinary changes, plan edits and merges share preparation and publication, and the separate orchestration and recovery branches are deleted.

items.title: Make preflight and the commit gate two stages of one execution

steps.title: Make preflight and the commit gate two stages of one execution
steps.rationale: Preflight runs the gate's own check definitions, and the gate then repeats every successful check (preflight.go:107). Retain pure checks' results against their exact inputs. When the candidate freezes, re-run only checks whose inputs changed or whose contract needs live state. Claims, current policy and publication stay fresh. Done when an unchanged candidate repeats no pure static check and a changed input invalidates exactly its checks.

items.title: Derive validation selection and evidence identity from one dependency description

steps.title: Derive validation selection and evidence identity from one dependency description
steps.rationale: longform.Affected (impact.go:20) and inferencesurface (surface.go:45) decide the relevant inputs separately; they disagreed on embedded files and go.mod until ed4d2b3a. One owner should supply both the selected input set and its digest. Then split unrelated capability dependencies only where measured invalidation shows a benefit, with no new exclusion table. Done when no input change can be unaffected for scheduling yet invalidate retained evidence, or the reverse.

items.title: Share claim mechanics across locks while keeping each resource's rules

steps.title: Share claim mechanics across locks while keeping each resource's rules
steps.rationale: processlock, authoritylock, device resource jobs, the gate lanes lock and plan row claims each repeat holder identity, acquisition, cancellation, release, liveness and diagnostics. Share those. Keep the different rules: database exclusion, durable task ownership, capacity-based GPU admission. Release happens when ownership ends; process exit is crash recovery, not the normal release. Done when the repeated liveness and recovery code is deleted, and a test shows a process releasing a resource, staying alive, and the next owner proceeding.

items.title: Bound peak memory at the store's copying points

steps.title: Bound peak memory at the store's copying points
steps.rationale: Three measured points: pack construction buffers payloads and verification reads whole packs (blob_pack.go:153); checkpoint creation serializes, restores and serializes a projection again to prove canonical form (checkpoints.go:57); retention copies catalog and graph state before computing reachability (retention.go:72). Share one bounded entry-reading and hashing path between lookup and verification, stream packs through the existing atomic publication, bound checkpoint concurrency, and traverse retention over the smallest stable representation. Keep every integrity check. Done when peak memory stays bounded as payload volume grows, with index memory accounted separately.

items.title: Declare storage class and retention on the document contract

steps.title: Declare storage class and retention on the document contract
steps.rationale: Storage classes are chosen by schema-name substrings (heartbeat, wakeup, poll, partial-output, liveness in storage_classes.go:34), a parallel registry that drifts from the contracts. Declare storage class, retention and publication owner beside each document contract, and delete the substring list. Retention separates required acceptance and recovery evidence from replaceable summaries and diagnostic detail, derives reports from retained results, and keeps explicit roots for outstanding work. Backup pruning stays operator policy.

items.title: Store medium payloads in immutable, size-bounded pack segments

steps.title: Store medium payloads in immutable, size-bounded pack segments
steps.rationale: After the publication, query and memory rows land, and only from measured record sizes, read patterns and compaction cost. Small transition records stay inline in journal entries, medium immutable payloads go to bounded pack segments, large tensors, media and logs to individually addressed blobs, indexes and checkpoints to replaceable derived generations, and live progress to bounded runtime state. Adding a small record must not rewrite an ever-growing pack, and one enormous file would trade file count for rewrite and recovery cost. Done when compaction write volume and open and replay time fall on the measured store without losing backup or recovery.

items.title: Cut the gate suite's longest tests

steps.title: Cut the gate suite's longest tests
steps.rationale: Measured 2026-09-23 at 83d0bb9b: suite 149-155 s. The critical path is the live fixture's single lock: ready at about 33 s, then 14 seeded plans run one at a time for about 103 s, and TestTestingReductionContract's five plans end the suite alone. Each plan recomputes whole-snapshot analyses for a one-file seed (codeprofile.Build 14 s, the consumer graph through go list 15 s, manifest identity 10 s and diff 6 s, CPU over five plans), so the content-keyed manifest cache never hits. Warming the base manifest in the fixture measured no gain. A pool of checkouts costs about 40 s of cold setup per extra slot and reverses the one-checkout budget. The structural lever is incremental analysis keyed per file or package (profile facts and consumer-graph edges reused for unchanged files), which also shortens every production gate's base-versus-candidate manifests.
